title: Use rval_to_str_const() when no specifier in 'unknown' string

notes.body: This would have had undefined behaviour (integer type substituted into %s)?

added 2 commits
  • 5d8edf73 - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • 8f7e63bc - Use rval_to_str_const() when no specifier in 'unknown' string
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/10397/diffs?diff_id=660863285&start_sha=1c351c41638f360c393a296aa2bbf9040d938295)
enabled an automatic merge when the pipeline for 8f7e63bcd9457bcdb6f96bf94f02df6f86895172 succeeds

I believe the packet-ieee1722.c case couldn't crash either
- mask is 0xFE00 (7 bits), data taken directly from frame
- act_msg_type_range_vals[] covers up to 0x007F, so unknown part can't be invoked

So although it was bad form and worth fixing, I don't think it needs to be back-ported.

changes_data.diff:
@@ -484,9 +484,9 @@ mpls_pm_build_cinfo(tvbuff_t *tvb, packet_info *pinfo, const char *str_pmt,
         col_add_fstr(pinfo->cinfo, COL_INFO,
                      "Response, sid: %u, code: %s (%u)",
                      *sid,
-                     rval_to_str(*code,
-                                 mpls_pm_response_ctrl_code_rvals,
-                                 "Unknown"),
+                     rval_to_str_const(*code,
+                                       mpls_pm_response_ctrl_code_rvals,
+                                       "Unknown"),
                      *code);
     }
 }

@@ -4077,9 +4077,9 @@ dissect_rsvp_tspec(proto_item *ti, packet_info* pinfo, proto_tree *rsvp_object_t
 
         proto_tree_add_item(rsvp_object_tree, hf_rsvp_tspec_multiplier, tvb, offset2 + 6, 2, ENC_BIG_ENDIAN);
         proto_item_append_text(ti, "Signal [%s], NMC %d, NVC %d, MT %d",
-                               rval_to_str(signal_type,
-                                           gmpls_g709_signal_type_rvals,
-                                           "Unknown"),
+                               rval_to_str_const(signal_type,
+                                                 gmpls_g709_signal_type_rvals,
+                                                 "Unknown"),
                                tvb_get_ntohs(tvb, offset2 + 2),
                                tvb_get_ntohs(tvb, offset2 + 4),
                                tvb_get_ntohs(tvb, offset2 + 6));
@@ -4313,9 +4313,9 @@ dissect_rsvp_flowspec(proto_item *ti, packet_info* pinfo, proto_tree *rsvp_objec
 
         proto_tree_add_item(rsvp_object_tree, hf_rsvp_flowspec_multiplier, tvb, offset2 + 6, 2, ENC_BIG_ENDIAN);
         proto_item_append_text(ti, "Signal [%s], NMC %d, NVC %d, MT %d",
-                               rval_to_str(signal_type,
-                                           gmpls_g709_signal_type_rvals,
-                                           "Unknown"),
+                               rval_to_str_const(signal_type,
+                                                 gmpls_g709_signal_type_rvals,
+                                                 "Unknown"),
                                tvb_get_ntohs(tvb, offset2 + 2),
                                tvb_get_ntohs(tvb, offset2 + 4),
                                tvb_get_ntohs(tvb, offset2 + 6));
